title: A companion's regard can change with no on-screen attribution at all: killing the ash wolf at Twin Stones only printed 'Lys disapproves (-1)', but the next status check showed Brother Osk had also dropped to regard -1 with no message ever shown crediting that or any earlier turn for the change.
where: Twin Stones (ash wolf fight) — discrepancy surfaced via status
